# GENmarketer AI Team Landing

> GENmarketer helps entrepreneurs, marketers, and small teams use AI specialists for practical marketing execution.

## Site
- Primary domain: https://genmarketer.hu/
- Product landing: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/
- English product landing: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/en/
- Knowledge base and checkout domain: https://tudastar.genmarketer.hu/

## Key Offering
- Product: AI Team / Az AI csapatod
- Format: 25 AI marketing specialists for Claude and ChatGPT workflows
- Typical use cases: market research, ad planning, PPC work, copywriting, landing page improvement, email reporting, video and UGC planning, competitor research, SEO and GEO work
- Hungarian pricing model: monthly subscription, two plans — Tervező (planner) 9 990 HUF/month and Autopilóta (autopilot) 19 990 HUF/month. No minimum term, cancel anytime, plan switching allowed.
- Plan difference: Tervező researches, audits and produces ready-to-use plans and copy; Autopilóta also connects to the customer's own Meta Ads, Google Ads, MailerLite and GA4 accounts and executes the approved work there.
- English pricing model: monthly subscription, two plans — Planner 29 EUR/month and Autopilot 59 EUR/month. No minimum term, cancel anytime, plan switching allowed. Same structure as the Hungarian offer, priced in euros.
- Purchase path: the Hungarian landing sends buyers to the GENmarketer knowledge base checkout (WooCommerce, HUF); the English landing uses its own Stripe checkout at /en/checkout/ (EUR). The two never mix — the shop currency is HUF, so the euro prices are billed by Stripe and mirrored into WooCommerce afterwards.
- Subscription self-service EN: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/en/manage/ — the customer requests an emailed link to the Stripe billing portal to change card, download invoices or cancel.

## Important Pages
- Product landing HU: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/
- Product landing EN: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/en/
- GENmarketer main site: https://genmarketer.hu/
- GENmarketer knowledge base: https://tudastar.genmarketer.hu/

## AI and Search Context
- The landing is a bilingual static site.
- The Hungarian root page is the default version.
- The English version is available under /en/.
- Canonical URLs and hreflang alternates are declared in the HTML head and sitemap.
- Structured data includes Organization, WebSite, WebPage, Product, Offer, ImageObject, and FAQPage entities.

## Audience
- Solo entrepreneurs
- Small agencies
- In-house marketers
- Course buyers who want a practical AI marketing workflow
